cleanup.title: cleanup
cleanup.description: Validate and resolve a biopolymer sequence expressed as a string to a string of valid biopolymer letters

resolveToSeq.title: resolveToSeq
resolveToSeq.description: This function takes in a string value, `seq`, and first converts it to a string if it is not. It then matches the regular expression pattern defined by the constant _regexDNA. If the input matches the pattern, the input is returned. Otherwise it throws an error.

comparePolynucleotides.title: comparePolynucleotides
comparePolynucleotides.description: Compares two Polynucleotide objects for equivalence. Handles linear vs circular cases, reverse complement cases, etc.

polyrevcomp.title: polyrevcomp
polyrevcomp.description: Reverse complements a Polynucleotide object, reversing its sequence and swapping extensions/modifications.

polynucleotide.title: polynucleotide
polynucleotide.description: Creates a new polynucleotide (DNA or RNA) object as JSON

dsDNA.title: dsDNA
dsDNA.description: Creates a Polynucleotide object (as JSON) representing a blunt-ended, double-stranded DNA such as results from PCR or GBlock synthesis.  It lacks 5' phosphates.

oligo.title: oligo
oligo.description: Creates a Polynucleotide object (as JSON) representing a linear single stranded DNA (an oligonucleotide)

plasmid.title: plasmid
plasmid.description: Creates a Polynucleotide object (as JSON) representing a circular doubkle stranded DNA (a plasmid)

resolveToPoly.title: resolveToPoly
resolveToPoly.description: For resolving a string to a Polynucleotide object

isPalindromic.title: isPalindromic
isPalindromic.description: Determines whether a given DNA sequence is palindromic. A palindromic DNA sequence is one that reads the same forward and backward when complemented. This function also checks for invalid characters in the input sequence and throws an exception if any are found.

revcomp.title: revcomp
revcomp.description: Calculates the reverse complement of a DNA sequence, including handling of degeneracy codes.

gccontent.title: gccontent
gccontent.description: Calculates the G/C content of a DNA sequence.

basebalance.title: basebalance
basebalance.description: Calculates the base balance of a DNA sequence.

maxrepeat.title: maxrepeat
maxrepeat.description: Finds the longest streak of repeating bases in a DNA sequence.

translate.title: translate
translate.description: Translates a DNA sequence to an amino acid sequence (single-letter codes, no stop codons). Throws if the input is not a string, or contains invalid DNA letters.

annotateSequence.title: annotateSequence
annotateSequence.description: Annotates a sequence. Smart matching using full exact matching (no k-mer seeding)

findNonExpressedCDS.title: findNonExpressedCDS
findNonExpressedCDS.description: Find non expressed coding DNA sequences (CDS)

removeSites.title: removeSites
removeSites.description: Remove restriction enzyme sites by replacing them with a different sequence that encodes the same amino acids.

oneAAoneCodon.title: oneAAoneCodon
oneAAoneCodon.description: Returns a polynucleotide sequence with a single codon per amino acid given a polypeptide sequence.

scoreanneal.title: scoreanneal
scoreanneal.description: Calculates a score for an annealing sequence based on various criteria.

findanneal.title: findanneal
findanneal.description: Returns the best annealing sequence for an input DNA sequence.

pca.title: pca
pca.description: PCA function that generates oligos for a synthon using the polymerase chain assembly method.

lca.title: lca
lca.description: LCA function that generates oligos for a synthon using the ligase chain assembly method.

bglbrick.title: bglbrick
bglbrick.description: Designs oligos or gene synthesis sequences for a BlgBrick part based on the input parameters.

biobrick.title: biobrick
biobrick.description: Designs oligos or gene synthesis sequences for a BioBrick (RFC10).

moclo.title: moclo
moclo.description: A function to design a forward or reverse oligo for MoClo cloning

genejoin.title: genejoin
genejoin.description: Designs oligos for PCR and subsequent homology-based assembly of two DNA sequences into one molecule. It takes in two DNA sequences as input and returns the designed oligos as output. The function is useful for joining overlapping DNA fragments or inserting a DNA fragment into a larger construct using homology-based assembly methods such as SOEing, Gibson assembly, or yeast homologous recombination.

rbslib.title: rbslib
rbslib.description: Designs a ribosome binding site library of MoClo UC type.

displaySeq.title: displaySeq
displaySeq.description: Helper to display a sequence with context for error messages

parseCF.title: parseCF
parseCF.description: Parses a construction file (CF) and sequences into the appropriate steps and sequences.

PCR.title: PCR
PCR.description: PCR function predicts the sequence of a PCR product by inputting forward oligo sequence, reverse oligo sequence, and template sequence.

sortAndValidateGoldenGateFragments.title: sortAndValidateGoldenGateFragments
sortAndValidateGoldenGateFragments.description: Helper for Golden Gate assembly: sort and validate fragments by sticky ends

ligate.title: ligate
ligate.description: Simulates ligation of Polynucleotides by matching sticky ends.

join.title: join
join.description: Helper to join two Polynucleotides if their ends are compatible and have proper modifications

ligateEnds.title: ligateEnds
ligateEnds.description: Helper to circularize a Polynucleotide if its ends are compatible and have proper modifications

goldengate.title: goldengate
goldengate.description: Assembles a set of Polynucleotide objects using the Golden Gate Assembly method.

gibson.title: gibson
gibson.description: Assembles DNA Polynucleotide objects using the Gibson assembly method.

cutOnce.title: cutOnce
cutOnce.description: Cuts a given polynucleotide once with a specified restriction enzyme and returns the resulting fragments as a JSON string.

digest.title: digest
digest.description: Performs a restriction digest to completion on a given DNA Polynucleotide using specified enzymes, and returns a specific fragment.

simCF.title: simCF
simCF.description: A function that simulates a series of molecular biology construction steps given a construction file object.

merge.title: merge
merge.description: Function to merge multiple strings or arrays into a single string with a delimiter

field.title: field
field.description: Function to extract a field from a JSON object or array as a string

makeJSON.title: makeJSON
makeJSON.description: Converts an array of [key, value] pairs into a JSON object string
